name: Avalara
summary: Avalara's sales tax product page describes rooftop-accurate tax calculation, economic nexus tracking and automated filing. The Core Compliance plan costs $79 per state per month, or $799 per state per year, with a three-state minimum. A second plan at $69 per state per month adds Streamlined Sales Tax services, including a single SST registration ID and state-funded calculation and filing in up to 25 states for qualifying sellers.

facts.text: Avalara's e-invoicing page says it is a certified Peppol Access Point service provider, with access to the Peppol network in European countries, Australia, New Zealand, Malaysia and Japan.
The e-invoicing page describes transaction-only pricing and publishes no e-invoicing rates.
Registration in states outside the Streamlined Sales Tax program is a separate service, and the pricing page gives no price for it.
Avalara says its AvaTax global platform has achieved SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.
Avalara cites more than 1,400 signed partner integrations and custom APIs.
The SST plan page says Avalara is a Certified Service Provider in 24 SST member and associate states plus Pennsylvania, and lists $69 per state per month for other states where a seller files.
Businesses with $50 million or more in annual revenue are sent to a custom plan with no published price.
